Q'umirlla k'anchaq {player_id} kanki **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**-pi.
Kamaykunata **[macro  micro]** (iskay yupay 0-8) hinam qillqa:
• *macro*  = mayqin mini-tablero-pi pukllanki
• *micro* = mayqin casilla-pi mini-tablero-pi
Shembłu `[7 8]` ➜ q'umir markaykita mini-tablero 7-pi, casilla 8-pi, churasqa
k'umirlla wawqi-kuna pukllayta mini-tablero 8-pi q'ati.

Q'umir {symbol} kanki.
